Beast Mastery Hunter

Ranged physical damage with a pet that carries a real share of the work, and from level 25, hawks.

WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

Levelling and level 60 guide for the live game. Talents start at level 10 and each row costs five more points in the tree, so the rows open at levels 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40. The builds are Icy Veins' and Wowhead's, named and dated; both sites' builds were written at or just after launch, before the November 10 tuning. Numbers are the client's with hotfixes through November 12. Rotation choices past 30 cite WoWSims, a model fitted to combat logs at levels 34 to 48. No raid is open until December 9. Legacy's TalentedTalentedTalentCastInstantYou gain talent points every level starting at level 5 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points. perk starts talent points five levels early, so Summon HawkSummon HawkTalent · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost11% of base ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownCommand a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing (32 + 5% of ranged attack power) Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot. can land at 20 instead of 25. Where a hover tooltip and the text disagree, believe the text: tooltips can lag a hotfix.

What Beast Mastery is for

The pet tanks and hits, and the tree makes both better. Focused FireFocused FireTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases all damage you and your pet deal by 2% while your pet is active. raises your damage and your pet's together while the pet is out. Unleashed FuryUnleashed FuryTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 15%. and FerocityFerocityTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 10%. raise pet and hawk damage and crit. Endurance TrainingEndurance TrainingTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases the Health and Armor of your pets by 15%. gives the pet Health and Armor in one talent.

While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 10% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. gives Auto ShotAuto ShotLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantRange35 yd rangeAutomatically shoots the target until cancelled. a 10% chance at 5/5 of +30% ranged attack speed for 12 seconds, and only while Aspect of the HawkAspect of the HawkLevel 10 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost20 ManaDurationUntil cancelledThe hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 20. Only one Aspect can be active at a time. is up. Those figures are the client's. Icy Veins calls it "one of the strongest Hunter talents anywhere on the tree." The talent has a melee half too, off Aspect of the BeastAspect of the BeastSpell · Nature · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost50 ManaDurationUntil cancelledThe hunter takes on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable and increasing Melee Attack Power by 50. Only one Aspect can be active at a time..

Summon HawkSummon HawkTalent · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost11% of base ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownCommand a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing (32 + 5% of ranged attack power) Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot. at 16 points adds a second and third attacker. IntimidationIntimidationTalentCastInstantCost8% of base ManaRange100 yd rangeCooldown60 sec cooldownDuration15 secCommand your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat. at 21 is a 3-second pet stun on a 1-minute cooldown that also gives the pet's next attack +100% crit chance. Bestial WrathBestial WrathTalentCastInstantCost12% of base ManaRange100 yd rangeCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration18 secSend your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed. at 31 points, level 40, gives the pet +50% damage for 18 seconds on a 2-minute cooldown and makes it immune to crowd control.

Icy Veins' verdict on taming a pet at level 10: "the single greatest leveling tool that any class gets, without exception." Wowhead notes the first solo level 60 on launch realms was a Beast Mastery Hunter using the pet to tank.

Learn the dead zone immediately. Below level 10, kite backwards between shots. You want as many ranged attacks in as possible before the enemy closes.

Early Hunter is mostly Auto Shot, and that is by design. Icy Veins' levelling priority:

What decides each press:

  • Stand still for Auto Shot. Blizzard's notes say Auto Shot needs 0.5 seconds standing still before it fires, and that it keeps firing while you cast Aimed ShotAimed ShotLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6Cast2 sec castCost75 ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownAn aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 40. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.. So the cast costs you no Auto Shots and walking does. When kiting, walk between shots and stop before the next one is due.
  • Serpent StingSerpent StingLevel 4 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost15 ManaRange35 yd rangeDuration15 secStings the target, causing 15 Nature damage over 15 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target. or Arcane ShotArcane ShotLevel 6 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost11% of base ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownAn instant shot that causes 25 Arcane damage.. The sting is the better use of Mana if the target lives. Rank 3 costs 50 Mana and deals 70 over 15 seconds, against 50 for Arcane Shot at level 20. Rank 4 costs 80 and deals 130, against 85 at level 28. All before attack power, which widens the gap: each tick of the sting adds 5% of it, 25% over the full sting, against 15% for Arcane Shot. Those shares are Blizzard's November 2 figures, and WoWSims reports level 34 and 36 combat logs fit both. The sting ticks every 3 seconds and passes Arcane Shot on its fourth tick, at 12 seconds. On a target with less time than that, skip it.

Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.. They share a 6-second cooldown, so you get one or the other. Aimed Shot is your weapon hit plus a flat bonus: 40 at rank 1, 70 at rank 2, up to 350 at rank 6. Multi-Shot is the weapon hit with no bonus, on up to three targets. Each extra target adds a whole weapon hit, so two targets beat Aimed Shot once your weapon hit is larger than that bonus.

The shared cooldown is 6 seconds and a hawk lasts 18, with two up at most, so two presses in every three keep both hawks out and the third is free. The dive alone is the weaker hit: 32 plus 5% of ranged attack power at rank 1. A hawk's worth is in the 18 seconds after it. On a target about to die, press Arcane Shot.

Stat priority

While levelling: weapon damage, then Agility, and past that, take the higher item level.

Weapon damage is "far and away your most important stat" (Icy Veins), and the slower weapon is better. Aimed ShotAimed ShotLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6Cast2 sec castCost75 ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownAn aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 40. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot. calculates from your weapon's damage per hit, not its DPS.

At 60 the two sites agree on the order and disagree on the hit cap. Both list hit, then crit, then Agility, then Intellect, then Attack Power. Wowhead says 9% hit and labels its list speculative. Icy Veins says 8%. Intellect counts because Careful AimCareful AimTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect. turns it into Attack Power one for one at 5/5.

Your pet

  • Pets get increased stats from your own gear, and Blizzard confirms that is now the only way to buff them. Pets can no longer receive player buffs that increase their stats.
  • Pet Health was tuned on November 10. Blizzard found pets at 150% of normal Health by a bug and set them to 115%, aiming for Classic Era's durability.
  • Family still matters for damage, on the client's reading. Icy Veins says pets have no inherent damage difference by type. The client's family table, Wowhead and WoWSims all say Cats and Raptors deal 10% more and Bears 9% less. The table is on the Hunter overview.
  • Which pet. Icy Veins recommends a Bear for SwipeSwipeLevel 12 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost20 FocusRangeMeleeCooldown5 sec cooldownSwipe 3 nearby enemies, inflicting 4 damage., a 5-second-cooldown frontal cleave and "one of the rare pet abilities capable of dealing consistent AoE damage to hold aggro on multiple targets." Wowhead recommends a Cat or Raptor for damage, or a Carrion Bird for Demoralizing ScreechDemoralizing ScreechTalent · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost20 FocusRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration30 secBlasts a single enemy for 7 to 9 damage and lowers the melee attack power of all enemies in melee range by 63 for 30 sec.. WoWSims' presets use a Raptor (WoWSims' model).
  • The pet's attack power is set when you call it. In WoWSims' level 34 to 36 logs the pet's attack power held through 20 Aspect of the HawkAspect of the HawkLevel 10 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost20 ManaDurationUntil cancelledThe hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 20. Only one Aspect can be active at a time. toggles and a gear swap, so it reads the inherited attack power and Health as taken at the summon (WoWSims' reading of the logs). Call the pet in the gear you fight in.
  • Rapid FireRapid FireLevel 26 · Spell · ArcaneCastInstantCost100 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 sec. speeds the pet up too. The same logs show the pet swinging 40% faster under it, and faster again with its own FrenzyFrenzyTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantGives your pet a 100% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.. Ranged-only haste does not reach the pet (WoWSims' reading of the logs).
  • Happiness and loyalty still exist. Feed your pet: Wowhead notes an unhappy pet deals less damage.
  • Ability ranks are taught, not inherited. Tame a beast that already knows the rank, use it until the chat line says you learned it, take your own pet back, and teach it with Beast Training. Wowhead suggests new ranks of ClawClawLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost25 FocusRangeMeleeClaw the enemy, causing 4 to 6 damage. and BiteBiteLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost35 FocusRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownBite the enemy, causing 7 to 9 damage. about every 10 levels. Tame BeastTame BeastSpell · NatureCastInstantCost60% of base ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration20 secBegins taming a beast to be your companion. Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the beast for 20 sec. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail. Once tamed, the beast will be very unhappy and disloyal. Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy. does not work on beasts above your own level.
  • Every family can now learn either BiteBiteLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost35 FocusRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownBite the enemy, causing 7 to 9 damage. or ClawClawLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost25 FocusRangeMeleeClaw the enemy, causing 4 to 6 damage. (some both), and either DiveDiveSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost20 FocusCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases movement speed by 40% for 15 sec. or DashDashSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost20 FocusCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases movement speed by 40% for 15 sec., on top of one ability unique to that family.
  • Aggressive Mode is back, in the pet tab of your spellbook.
  • Threat. Send the pet first and give it a couple of attacks before you shoot. On several targets you out-threaten it, which is the case for a Bear, or for fewer targets.

At level 60

The build and the rotation above are published. What is not yet known is how they hold in a raid: none opens until December 9. Both sites' level 60 builds predate the November 10 hawk and pet tuning, and only WoWSims has re-run since (WoWSims' model). In a dungeon your pet is not the tank: keep it on the tank's target, and use Feign DeathFeign DeathLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost80 ManaCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration360 secFeign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Lasts 360 sec. If not cancelled, after 360 sec you will actually die. when you pull threat.
